about: Efexor-XR (venlafaxine), by brand name only, is supplied eight times from September 2025 to March 2026 to a 72-year-old.
Bupropion (Zyban) 150 mg twice a day is supplied three times from December 2025 to February 2026, in the middle of a 15-month history.
Mirtazapine, an antidepressant that is not in the group, is supplied monthly. None of bupropion, venlafaxine or reboxetine appears.
